Stay local or approve AI

05 / OPTIONAL INTELLIGENCE

Your model.
Your choice.

Connect an AI provider when you are ready to ask more of your reviewed data.

CLOUD PROVIDERS

OpenAI.
Claude. Gemini.

Choose a model available to your provider account and connect with an API key. Approve the data sent for analysis.

Cloud APIs use provider billing. A ChatGPT or Claude consumer login does not connect in-app analysis.
LOCAL RUNTIMES

Ollama.
llama.cpp. LM Studio.

Select a compatible model exposed by your local runtime for chat and report analysis on your Mac.

Local connections use loopback addresses. Optional runtime tokens are kept in Keychain.

AI interpretation remains separate from the verified report data.

09 / BEFORE YOU BEGIN

A few clear answers.

What can I import?

PDF, PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, CSV, TSV, JSON, XLSX, XLS, Markdown and plain text. Check extracted values against the original report.

Can I use UpOn without cloud AI?

Yes. Local extraction, verification, trends, history and exports work without a cloud model. AI analysis is an optional step.

Can I use my ChatGPT or Claude login?

In-app cloud analysis uses OpenAI Platform, Anthropic or Gemini API keys. Consumer website logins are not reused. Local models can connect through Ollama, llama.cpp or LM Studio.

Where does my health data live?

Records and profile data are kept in an encrypted local vault on your Mac. A cloud provider receives data only for a request you approve.

Does UpOn diagnose medical conditions?

UpOn is educational software for organizing and understanding health information. It is not a medical device, diagnostic tool or substitute for a qualified healthcare professional.
